# AIS-EVAL-01

**Does every model-backed element have evals with a metric and a threshold?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | EVAL: Evaluation as evidence |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.evals` |

## Why it matters

For a non-deterministic component, the eval suite is the test suite and the acceptance criterion.

## Rule

Every ai facet has at least one eval.

- Microsoft, Azure Well-Architected Framework, AI workloads (`azure-ai`)
